nom: Murad Clarifying Toner for Acne-Prone Skin

avis.texte: This toner can be harsh sometimes. It might burn like once a week but by god does my skin feel soooo clean after I use it. I have oily acne-prone skin so while I have to alter the rest of my routine on the occasional night it does zing, it really works wonders! 100% not for those with sensitive skin!

This is my first time trying this toner and i honestly dont know how to feel about it, it has a really strong smell maybe like an alcohol smell, and it burns my eyes maybe i got to closed to the eye area but it was burning for like 5 minutes, it makes my face feel clean at first but then after a while it does makes it oily, im going to give it one more try and then decided.

I love Murad products and was so excited to try this but good lord - it HURT! Literally felt like my face was burning and was so painful during and after using. After one use completely dried my skin out! Will be returning!
Love all the murad products I've tried! This definitely helps clear my acne prone skin.

I dont even know how this product works unfortunately because I didn't survive using it more than twice. The smell of it made me gag so I had to return. I absolutely love Murad's clarifying acne face wash so I thought I would get this to go with the wash, but I just couldn't get past the smell.
I love using this toner after washing my face. Removes any excess makeup that my facewash didn't remove.
This is my first review I've made for a product - this deserved it! My favorite alcohol free toner. Breakouts are rare for me since I've added this to my routine.

I have combo type skin. First im going to say, as soon as I applied it to my face, I got a burning sensation that wasn't pleasant (my skin is sensitive) second, I'm going to say that this product has a STRONG smell! It almost smells like grape and it gave me a bit of a vertigo. Third i did see my pores minimizing and I would give this product about a month till I make a final choice.
I have combination skin, and this toner is the best one I've ever used. I love the cooling sensation it has, and I love the way it works on my skin.
Best toner I've ever used the second I started using it I could tell a difference and been using it for 5+ years now I can still see a difference
This is a good toner if you blackheads or breakouts. It can be a little drying but as long as you moisturize after you will be good!

avis.titre: Wanted to love but not for sensitive acne prone skin
avis.texte: This product is good for some who don't have sensitive dry skin in certain areas of the skin. This toner contains alcohol in it so beware of that ingredient. I would have never purchased this if I knew, but it did clear my skin overall but on certain areas was left very dry! So beware before spending money on an expensive product.
Favorite toner. Will never use anything else. Refreshing. Must try!!!

I have oily, acne prone skin and this changed the game. My skin has definitely gotten better! Not nearly as many breakouts! I can't find a comparable dupe anyway so I will repurchase over and over again. I have 4x already.

I'm obsessed. I kept my eyes peeled for a toner for the last few weeks. I didn't think it was really a necessity for my skin and boy was I wrong. This stuff is a GAME CHANGER! My skin is normal not oily but not sensitive, I'm almost 30 and really wanted to start taking care of my skin. Mind you, I never leave reviews, so this should let you know how much I love this product! The cooling sensation was beyond amazing and so refreshing. My skin is so soft after using it and when I apply my skincare after applying this, my face continues to hold onto that cool sensation! I removed so much extra dirt I didn't think was still ok my skin with this as well as my pimples already clearing up after one day of morning and night use. It's perfect! So happy with my first Murad purchase! 10 stars, recommend!!
Clean refreshing feeling afterwards. Like the smell and feel of product. Switch from Clinique clarifying lotion #4 to this. Hope it works.

I really liked Murad's cleanser so I thought I'd give the toner from the same line a go. Unfortunately it did little to help my acne prone skin and did everything to irritate it. My skin was red and irritated and it stung so bad one time that I had to wash the product off. I wanted to like it, but after that I knew it couldn't go back on my face.
The only thing that calms my face when I'm suffering from hormonal breakouts. Use 2x after washing and before moisturizing. Feels and smells delightful.

In our Southern humid summers, my normal/dry skin turns into an oil field! Murad's Clarifying Cleanser, Toner and Mattifier keep my skin looking bright, clear and matte. This toner is a workhorse - it does an excellent job of keeping my pores clean without drying out my skin. Plus, I adore the cool and refreshing feeling of this toner!
I have oily skin, not sensitive at all. After using for a few days my face is red and peeling. Feels like it is very tight and burning.
love using this after I wash my face with the fave wash. It's cooling and refreshing.

been using this for yrs and will not stop buying this. definitely is amazing for my skin, i have combo skin and my aesthetician recommended this for me. it tingles when you put it on and just makes your skin feel so clean and ready for the products on top

avis.titre: Small Bumps all over my face.
avis.texte: I bought this product to control my blackheads and breakouts but this product has only made my skin worse. After a few days, I noticed little bumps starting to form around my chin and lower cheek area. Within a week, the bumps have spread to the upper part of my checks. I love the brand but this particular product was a disappointment.

avis.titre: Burns Face - Would NOT Recommend for Sensitive Skin
avis.texte: I purchased this product because I am a fan of other Murad products and was looking for a new toner. I was disappointed to find that this toner made my skin burn after using it. I have combination/sensitive skin and would not recommend this for others with my skin type. The bottle describes this feeling as "refreshing" - I think otherwise.
This product really helped clear my skin paired with the cleanser. It didn't sting at all. It actually had a cooling sensation.

Tried this product & WOW! It feels amazing. A clean & tingly fresh sensation. & my skin felt so much smoother after the first use. & any redness seemed to fade away. Very pleased so far and can't wait to see how things look after this bottle. So far so great!

avis.titre: It's ok for non sensitive skin
avis.texte: I bought this because I was recommended for my oily skin and sensitive but it still burned like crazy.

I have been using this product for years it is definitely changed my skin. it's very clarifying a tingly feeling I use it before my moisturizer in the morning and before my nighttime skin care. will continue to buy

avis.titre: not the best u can find
avis.texte: this is basically astringent. i haven't seen any benefits from using this product and ur money and time could be spent on better toners that will help your skin.

I never leave reviews but this product absolutely deserves one. I have combination acne prone skin, with large pores. This toner not only feels cooling and refreshing on the skin but I saw a difference in my pores and redness of my skin after just a few uses! My holy grail toner!!
Love this toner but makes my skin a tad oily about 1/2 hour after I use it if I don't use makeup.

avis.titre: Purchased this for the second time
avis.texte: I love that this product helps with my oily skin but it's not the best at keeping my acne at bay. Still love it enough to buy it again.

avis.auteur: Refreshed but didn't improve my pores
avis.texte: This did not do anything for my pores to be honest. But, it left my skin feeling nice and clean. I enjoy it. Although it is actually really intense. I have sensitive skin, but it didn't irritate it.

The lid on this bottle is just all wrong. It should be a tiny hole and you could squeeze the liquid out. This bottle has a large opening and tons of fluid comes out all at once. I have spilled quite a bit. It should have a portion control lid. Otherwise, I like it. It does the job and I didn't break out.

I really like this toner a lot! I was so excited to try it. I have sensitive acne prone skin and had been suffering from crisis of acne recently but this really did help. I've been using it for two weeks already morning and at night when I wash my face and I just love it!

I am 60+ in age and I can't believe I still suffer from incredibly oily skin. It's been that way all my life. Along with the oil I have break-outs. This toner really helps with the acne and it may even be helping with the oil a little bit. I will continue to use this and try some other Murad prdts.

Right off the bat the tingling sensation caught me off guard but I did enjoy it. I can also understand that it may not be for everyone. I don't consider my skin to be super sensitive but it does get angry ( in terms of break outs) when I use the wrong products. So far my skin has been loving this toner and unlike other toners I've used, and I've used plenty both budget and higher end products, this one does not leave my skin tacky and that's what I enjoy most. I do have the occasional cystic acne emerge but this has kept them at bay. Food also has a huge impact on those breakouts so of course this can't be magic in bottle but it's been good to my skin so far.
This product it's amazing specially for oil skins leave my skin soft, fresh and no oily very good murad

Tried this an immediately burned. Felt like listerine on my face. Hasn't cause too much of irritation after I tolerated the burning but used another step from murad after that left a film on my skin. I was trying to swap from Dermalogica to something slightly more cost efficient, but not worth it

avis.titre: Second time buying this product, I will continue to buy
avis.texte: I use this twice a day, really helps get deep in your pores to get make up off after a good face wash.

avis.titre: Very disappointed - Not good for sensitive skin
avis.texte: I've struggled with acne for the past six years of my life and I was hoping that this toner would help clarify some of the blemishes and flaring acne spots that I get it but unfortunately it just made the problem worse my face got really irritated and I saw more small bumps appearing on my cheeks. I tried to use this product for about four days with hope that my skin would adapt and heal but it just got worse now I have a red irritated face that burns and itches. :(

I've been using Murad's acne control cleanser for about 6 months now, so I decided to try out the toner at a friend's house and now I'm obsessed. I have dry/combination skin with hormonal acne flare ups on my contour lines/outer cheeks and jawline, and this product has helped control those breakouts! Plus the cucumber and menthol feels super refreshing (in small amounts; don't go overboard or you'll end up with a weird stinging sensation). Tip for dry skin people: as long as you heavily moisturize, maybe with some hyaluronic acid and a facial oil included, you'll be just fine!
I absolutely love this toner after trying it for the first time. It cleanses your skin after washing it and you can feel that your skin is balanced afterwards without any drying effects.

I attempted to switch from this to The Ordinary's toner, and I made a terrible mistake. The switch was only due to price, but I'm back with Murad now. It doesn't leave my skin feeling too oily or too dry. I love the smell of it too!

Been using this toner in the evenings after cleansing. I have adult acne, large pores and oily skin in the summer. It shrinks my pores and makes my skin feel super clean! It also helps keeps my skin clear.

avis.titre: Super cool feeling after apply with alcohol smell
avis.texte: I have been using for week now. This is so strongly alcohol smell and cool or burn feeling something that i can't explain BUT it doesn't real burn/break out/dry out on my face. My face is getting less oily during the day. For acne, can't say anything yet.
I had to return it because it was too harsh on my skin. The "cooling effect" actually burned me. This is more of an astringent. And this cause some dry patches on my face.

once I started using this toner my acne problems vanished!!! my face cleared up so fast!!! I started using it on my arms now and its AMAZING. its clearing up my KP as well!!!! awesome product worth EVERY PENNY!!!

This feels much more like an astringent than what I expected. It makes your skin feel tight and squeaky clean, but not in a good way. the cooling would be nice if it didn't seem to turn to almost a slight burning feeling right after from the alcohol drying. 2 stars because I can use it for bacne, but no more for my face.
This is my new fave! i love how it makes my skin feel fresh and clean. and the scent isn't overwhelming.

I usually love Murad products, but this just makes my face feel tight and dry after toning because of the alcohol in it. might be better for more oily skin, but since I'm more dry this did not feel good nor did I see any benefit to it added into my skincare routine
ironically, this broke me out. i gave it to someone else to try and it broke them out too. hard pass.
I am normally a budget buyer but this is something to splurge on. It's amazing and has really helped my skin!

I love this stuff! I have used many toners, both name brand and not, and this has been the best I have used. I break out from hormones and this has helped tremendously at keeping my breakouts at bay. I can not go without this!!
This toner is the best in out there it helps with my acne and oily skin I use it day and night and it makes a huge difference in my skin care routine

I was sceptical about this purchase but the associate as Ulta convencied me this helped her skin so I tried it out. I was having spots of large cyst acne on my chin and jaw line, and the Murad toner along with the acne wash cleared up my acne and my skin is looking better then ever after 2 months of using.

avis.titre: better for oily skin, too harsh for combo/dry
avis.texte: I struggle with acne and absolutely love murad products but I found this toner to be a little too intense for my sensitive skin. It makes my skin feel tight and can irritate my redness. So I don't use it everyday, but I do like to use it when my acne is flaring up. Overall I think this is better suited for someone with oily skin. (my skin is combo). The murad hydrating toner helps my acne but doesn't irritate my skin, I would recommend that one instead if you have combo/dry skin.
I sampled this toner and bought it because I like the clean feel it leaves as well as it improves my acne.

avis.titre: This item will always be a part of my regiment
avis.texte: I use this product twice a day! I was my face every night before bed and when I wake up in the morning this always removes any oil and dirt my face accumulates over night. It's also great to use after my makeup removing wipes, it gets any makeup left in my pores.

I was looking for a toner that would assist with my acne, as well as my blotchy red skin. This toner didn't solve all my problems, but I feel like it did a really good job. My skin in the morning is REALLY oily and the first thing I do is put this on a cotton pad and wipe off my face. It leaves me feeling fresh and ready for makeup.

I use this day and night and it keeps my breakouts under control. Went without it for about a month to test another toner but it wasn't working for me. My estitician recommends this and I will continue to use.

I love Murad products and have never had any issues. Their Clarifying Cleanser and Oil Control Mask is amazing. However, this product is awful. At first, I loved it. My oily skin was now maintained for 8 hours and didn't look like I was sweating on my forehead. After 3 days, my skin on my face was irritated and I have little bumps all over. The last time I used it, my face got really red and it was almost like a burning sensation on my face. I do not have sensitive skin so I'm shocked at the outcome of this product. I do not recommend.

I needed something that gave my pores a deep cleaning and to help improve my acne prone skin. It works great! It reduces inflammation and I've seen a significant reduction in my breakouts and even with helping to reduce scarring from past breakouts!
I love this tone. It took me a few weeks to get daily use into my routine but my skin is glad I did.

I bought this product because I thought it would help minimize and possibly even eliminate blackheads. However, I used the whole bottle and didn't see any improvement. I didn't even find this to do much to remove any "dirt" that my cleanser left behind. After trying this toner and a few others, I've pretty much given up on toners.
Amazing, texture improved drastically. Little to no break outs.... I've used for 2 months now, daily.
I love this product. My only criticism is that I wish it had a sprayer like the other Murad toners...however, a standard one from the drug store screws right on to it.

So a review means you've used the product religiously for quite some time...not using it once and eating it 5 stars. Now that we have this out of the way I used about 3/4 of the bottle and havent noticed ANYTHING. It tingles so good and feels cool when you put it on and it made me think it would work. But using this every day for about a month hasn't done a single thing for my hormonal acne. It's a shame
Been using for about two weeks and i really like how it leaves my face feeling refreshed and very clean! Also my acne has been reducing since i started using this and the cleanser!

I have large, clogged pores and this product (along with the Murad clarifying clay mask) have really made a huge difference within a week. My pores appear smaller and less clogged and my skin texture is smoother. This product controls oil but does not cause dryness. Highly recommend!

This was recommended to me when I specifically inquired about a product containing witch hazel. You can definitely smell it, and it leaves my skin feelings SO clean and fresh. Careful around the eyes, it can be a bit strong smelling at first, and it will leave a tingling sensation. I've even used this on a rash that developed from an allergic reaction to dermabond stitches after nothing else worked and in just days I'm noticing a huge difference - finally!

I LOVE this toner. However, the smell is a bit much for me and not going to lie the first time I applied it I felt like it hurt my skin because it was a little much but nope, my acne was clearing up in just a matter of days of using it and did not leave my skin feeling dry i like the minty fresh feeling it leaves after use. What i love the most is that this brand is cruelty free.

avis.titre: My go to skin care line
avis.texte: I have used Murad products for years. I have had problem skin all my life and the Murad line was the first one that I could use without irritation. The toner doesn't sting, is light, doesn't smell. Use it twice a day every day.

I honestly just brought this because people keep on saying was a great toner but joy for me was too strong you can litellt smell the alcohol that' have in it and of course dry out my skin but this help dry out the pimples faster too

I have combination skin and I was looking for a product that would help with my acne without drying my skin. This toner works great to help control oil and clear problem areas on your face. The toner has a strong smell but other than that it great.

This is by far the best toner I have used for my combination skin. I am 44 years old. I also use the foaming face wash from Murad. It has helped my skin so much and I often receive compliments. I highly recommend this toner.

avis.titre: Finally!!!  Something for my daughter's sensitive skin!
avis.texte: My daughter has very sensitive skin, took a long time to find something that worked without overdrying.
I was really happy with this toner. I'm in my mid thirties and small acne issues are rising. I started this and saw quick results. Love it day and night.

I just started using this along with the entire acne line from Murad and I absolutely love it with just a little under a weeks use- I have already gotten compliments on my skin looking great! Very well worth the price so far
Very effective and really helped improve my skin. But be sure to moisturize with this product it is strong.
I absolutely love this product. I would absolutely racamend this product.

avis.titre: Yes . I love it . Great product
avis.texte: I'm happy to be a new Ulta customer . My experience in the store has always been great and warming

avis.titre: I absolutely love this product & would buy it again.
avis.texte: I use this product after I use cleanser, helps keep my face clear.
The product actually dried my skin out so much that it overproduced oil within a couple hours.

I recently got this for my boyfriend, since he loves using mine. He love sit just as much as i do! We can both agree it leaves such a clean feeling, you feel so fresh after you use it! Although it may burn at first when you first start testing out the product, he describes it as a good kind of burn. We both love it so much & definitely does help clear out skin from breakouts. Ive used about 4-5 bottles

Good toner. Definitely makes skin feel clean after use. The only negative is that it can make your skin a little dry, but nothing not expected with an acne toner. I recommend. FYI - I have combination skin.

My skin is combination/oily and relatively clear, but I still have acne that never clears 100% so I thought that using a toner such as this one would be the solution. I've never been one to use a toner, and after wasting my money on this product, I feel very hesitant to try purchasing a different one. This toner does its job to cleanse my skin, and it gives a cooling sensation after you use it, but I quit this product after 0 difference in two weeks (and going back to it every now and then, but still unsatisfied). My acne was the same, my pores were the same, and I honestly feel like I can get my skin clean enough without this toner in my skincare routine. It's an OK product if you're one to use toners, but I'm not completely sold.
This toner works well and leaves my skin feeling clean. I just dislike the smell. But that is tolerable.
Use toner after cleansing to rid leftover makeup. Leaves my face feeling fresh and clean. It helped to clear up some minor acne.

avis.titre: Definitely one of my go to products!
avis.texte: I use this twice a day, it leaves my face feeling clean even when I use it without washing my face. It does an Amazing job of removing all the dirt and oil from my face and I've noticed after the first three days using this, along with the rest of the skin care line, my face has cleared up significantly!!!!
I love the way this makes my skin feel. It tingles and my skin feels great and it doesn't dry it out

It feels so clean but without drying out your skin. It smells like mint and it's like you can feel it getting into your pores. I used to use Clinique products but after trying Murad I will never go back its just so much better on so many levels.

I have been using this in conjunction with the Murad Anti-Aging Acne Starter Kit and the combination has been incredible. It is a little pricey, but for clear skin, it is really worth the price. I have really sensitive skin, and have got chemical burns from some other acne solutions, so really sensitive skin. I will admit, this does have a bit of a sting to it, if I have scrubbed my face a bit rigorously, but there is no lasting irritation. So while I can't say much about this product on its own, with the kit, it is great!
it helps out a lot with acne but it dries out your skin a little bit. I would recommend using it every other two days and using a lotion after.
I love the feeling of my skin after I use this toner after I cleanse.

avis.titre: I would keep the trio going
avis.texte: I've used the cleansing cleaner for 8 years and I've added the toner and moisturizer to my regiment and I must admit I never used it before and now I know what I've been missing. With all 3, cleanser, toner and moisturizer, them blemishes I have are beginning to clear up to make my skin, less oily ( I have naturally oily skin) and I feel great about that.
I use this product daily. I feel that it removes impurities that may be left after cleansing.
This is my 2nd time purchasing this product. I absolutely love this!! It works wonders for acne prone oily skin and works the best with the Murad Clenser. I will be buying this forever

avis.titre: Refreshing and relieving -still new to the product
avis.texte: When it comes to my acne I am a brand buyer of something works I have only been using this for a week and so far so good. My skin feels more fresh and clean and I am starting to see some improvements

avis.titre: Best Toner that isn't too expensive!
avis.texte: I really wanted to get the Clarins toner but couldn't afford it at the time. I use the clarifying cleanser from Murad and this stuff is amazing. I have really bad adult acne and I've only been using it for a few days. Nothing else has made my skin clear up so fast. There is a tingly feeling when I put it on but it's hasn't irritated my skin. I actually enjoy the tingly feeling because it feels like it's killing all of the stuff on my face that brings the acne.

If you're looking for a legit balancing toner, this is for you. I was recently travelling for two months, and the new climate PLUS the return to my hometown caused my skin to really freak out. It became oily and broken out, which was new for me. Using the toner once a day normalized my skin in about a week. I wouldn't describe it as gentle, but with each use I can feel the product working on my skin. If you're not interested in a toner with a harsh smell/feel, I would consider something else. But this one really works if you're looking for something with more power. Be sure to really moisturize after each use to avoid your skin drying out!

I tend to use this product at night as a toner, rather than a cleansing oil. Using it after my skin care routine helps close my pores and rinses away any dirt and oils that may have been left behind. I would definitely buy this again and will be recommending it to friends and family.

avis.titre: Does great for my minor pimpled
avis.texte: Use after wash face. Gets missed dirt out. Nice clean feeling of face

It definitely leaves my skin feeling clean and primes it perfectly for moisturizer. I like a toner that cleans and balances my skin tone and this one does that. The witch hazel helps with irritation and leaves skin feeling clean without redness.
I cannot live without this product it leaves my skin so fresh and you can feel it working as soon as you put it on

I really wanted to love this product because I love murad! BUT I wouldn't recommend this for people who have sensitive skin. It really stinged while I would put it on! It also made me break out pretty bad. It also smelled really really strong! This might work well for others but not for me.

I have been suffering from adult acne the last 3 years and I have tried everything. So far the Murad line has been the most effective. I love this toner because it really leaves your skin feeling clean and non oily. There's a cooling feeling that I just love.
Great product, definitely recommend! It is kind of harsh so be careful with super sensitive skin!

avis.titre: The only product that has helped me with my acne!!!
avis.texte: I use it every morning and night after washing my face with the murad cleanser then I use a moisturizer for dry skin n my skin is always glowing. No more acne
